license_declaration.product_identity_source: Paizo Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Bestiary, OGL §15 Product Identity section
license_declaration.product_identity_note: Per docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md §2.1's per-book override note: within Bestiary 1 itself, classic SRD monster species names (e.g. "Ankheg", "Dark Creeper") are presumptively Open Game Content, not Product Identity, matching the original d20 SRD's declaration -- this book's monster `name`/`id` fields are therefore classified OGL, not PI, unlike a non-bestiary context where a named creature could be PI. Named deities, unique NPCs, and unique places would still be Product Identity if present; none were found in this book's free-text `description` fields during this pass.

screening_method_note: This is a heuristic first-pass screen against a bounded, documented term list (the 20 canonical Golarion core deity names) run over every free-text `description` value in this book's records (monster records carry no free-text field at all -- only mechanical stat-block fields, verified by enumerating all data keys across all 41 monster/*.json). It is NOT an exhaustive human legal review, and no claim of exhaustive PI-freedom is made for the 4 equipment `description` values screened, beyond: no substring match against the documented term list was found.

operator_sign_off.note: Set true only after an operator has reviewed this book's classification pass, per docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md's DRAFT header.
